notes: *an offering made by fire* is one substantive's multi-word rendering and stays whole with אִשֶּׁה, headed on *fire* (rules 19, 31); the supplied *made* completes the naming of the lexeme rather than predicating an event of a second noun, so rule 20's added-participle case does not reach it.
The phrase's single *the* goes to the present article on הַשְּׁמִינִי and not to the construct יוֹם (rule 47); the suffix of אִמּוֹ is unrepresented, the ASV writing *the dam* (rule 22).
